description: This Java source file defines an Android activity 'RunningProcesses' that displays a list of running application processes on the device. It fetches process info using ActivityManager, sorts and displays the process names, and allows the user to click on an item to see more details in a new activity.

classes.name: RunningProcesses
classes.description: Main activity that displays a list of running processes with click functionality to view detailed info.

classes.name: RunningProcesses.AppListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class providing process list data to the ListView.

classes.name: RunningProcesses.ListItem
classes.description: Wrapper class holding process info for list display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, fetches package manager, sets up the list adapter, and handles the empty list case.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item click, launching a new activity with details about the selected process.

methods.name: appForPosition
methods.description: Returns the ListItem at a given position.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the position (non-standard, usually would return item).

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses list item views, binds process name data.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Sets process name in the TextView within a list item.
